{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Group by species and compute mean flipper length
mean_flipper_by_species = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Find the species with the highest mean flipper length
species_with_highest_mean = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
mean_flipper_value = mean_flipper_by_species.max()

print(f'Mean flipper length by species:\n{mean_flipper_by_species}')
print(f'Species with highest mean flipper length: {species_with_highest_mean} ({mean_flipper_value:.2f} mm)')"}
